content: Auto-resolve vs played battle: Bannerlord runs most battles via mathematical simulation (MapEvent + SimulateBattle) and pauses campaign time during player missions; mods add time passage. Kenshi has no instanced battles, one seamless map. X4 Foundations runs two combat models for the same fight: in-sector high-attention (full physics, collision, firing arcs) and out-of-sector low-attention (point entities, hit-rate math, all turrets fire); both write to the same world state; players notice when outcomes diverge. Verified across sources.
